answer: At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a ivory tag. The terrace cap is checked at intake and orchard shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 21 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
